actions.action: Check soil moisture 3 inches down near each plant
If dry, water slowly at the base for 15-20 minutes
Set up 30-50% shade cloth or burlap on west and south sides
Adjust mulch to 2-3 inches, pulled back from stems
Prune dead twigs after scratch-testing for green wood in fall or spring
If still declining after two weeks, check roots for rot

reason: The answer identifies heat and drought stress as the main cause and recommends daily deep watering, shade and no feeding, matching the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
